verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-transcription product, but nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted, on-premises or offline deployment of Otter. Every documented capability (desktop app, MCP server, API, S3/Drive exports) runs against Otter's cloud service. Community comments describe recordings going to a cloud users don't control and users seeking offline or self-hosted alternatives, which is consistent with no such option existing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
